The Salary advance solution is aimed at enabling SMEs offer a salary advance proposition to their staff members to reduce additional financial constraints. Key Features & Benefits: • Digital loan product – No paper work required • Pre-approved credit limit – The limit of the loan shall be 30-50% of the net salary. • Instant disbursement into the DTB Salary Account - No follow up required for disbursement of the loan amount. • Deduction at source – Saves the employee from constant follow-ups from the Bank on repayment of the loan. • Short Tenure – Maximum of 30 days 38
